name: Dexi.io
description_en:
Dexi.io is a product in the Data integration category. Its directory profile covers Data Transformation, Data Extraction, API Integration, Master Data Management, Data Quality Control, Metadata Management, Compliance Tracking, Data Integration.

Additional listed capabilities include Data Analysis, Version Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: convert data into a required format or structure; combine information from connected sources; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

research_gaps.en: Official homepage includes a notice attributed to Engage3 recommending migration from Dexi to Mozenda. The same page contains unrelated gambling links, so current feature and operating claims need corroboration. The pricing URL redirects to Mozenda pricing; this is not a current Dexi quote. No cutoff date, migration parity, export method or entitlement transfer was verified. Raw homepage and redirected pricing reads saved privately; this record remains incomplete.
research_gaps.zh: 官网首页包含署名 Engage3、建议 Dexi 客户迁往 Mozenda 的公告，但同页有无关博彩链接，当前功能与运营主张需要交叉核对。定价 URL 跳转 Mozenda 定价，这不是现行 Dexi 报价。未确认截止日、迁移功能等价、导出方式或权限转移。首页与跳转定价读取保存在私有片段中，本档案仍未完成。
